newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-S.AFRICA SUPERSPORT SERIES SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-S.AFRICA SUPERSPORT SERIES SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores on the second day of four-day South African Supersport Series cricket matches on Saturday.
Durban: Natal 282 and 120-2 (Derek Crookes 52, Mark Bruyns 48 not out), Free State 160 (Boeta Dippenaar 81).
Port Elizabeth: Western Province 401-2 declared (Desmond Haynes 202 not out, Jacques Kallis 94), Eastern Province 128-4 (Louis Koen 82 not out).
